findings.explanation: The combined alkylating/antimetabolite overview explicitly distinguishes families; detailed fluoropyrimidine action, DPD and CREATE-X teaching is on fluorouracil and capecitabine. Ask comparisons support alias option A: class aliases stay on the combined overview, with 5-FU on the actual drug. No duplicate class record.
Vinca aliases moved to tubulin; the target and taxane text distinguish assembly/growth inhibition from stabilisation.
Brock 1979 raw abstract and targeted IARC toxicology supply the mechanistic link the label alone did not establish. The text attributes this and supplies no universal incidence.
Current label risks and the defined POEMS motivation replace inevitable ovarian loss. No trial benefit is made a universal protection guarantee.
The records do not infer subsequent benefit or cross-resistance from TOP1/TOP2 names. The unsourced common-efflux comparison is omitted.

Current complete/partial deficiency, immediate-treatment exception, no proven safe dose in complete deficiency and unavailable FDA-authorised test are explicit. Host handling and tumour response remain distinct.
Unsupported 2024 label attribution removed; current label and dated FDA update identify the scope.
Named vinorelbine, vincristine, eribulin, MMAE and DM1 labels support their distinct mechanisms. Interphase effects and uncertainty replace a universal all-cells-die reading.
The NCI purposes include cure, recurrence reduction, slowing growth and symptom relief, with actual clinical setting and comparator required.
Warning structures are compared without a comparative lung-event frequency. Product and population denominators remain separate; no extra unverified incidence is adopted.

Specified label masses replace a typical-drug ratio; one abstract-scoped 150-micrometre model observation, scoped patient pilots and the original oxygen geometry replace universal reach, bottleneck and superlative claims. Baker correction remains unread.
Primary TAK-500 papers establish CCR2/dazostinag identity; registry fields support enrolment and stopping reason separately.
The older first-in-human status remains UNKNOWN, distinct from the terminated combination study.
Named laboratory activation, non-breast 18-person cohort, and activated dendritic-cell/CD8 findings are scoped. No family-wide safety or efficacy implication.
Takegawa alternatives, Rampa payload factors, source-specific DXd identity and Weng traceless constructs remain distinct.
Zoppoli NCI-60 and silencing experiments span several DNA-damaging categories; a different class does not guarantee escape.
The record states five design questions plus biological cell-response context. No Guide diagram is copied; caption correction remains with its owner.
N-acetylcysteine poisoning evidence, OATP transport, released-species permeability, Ren preclinical scope and clinical delivery remain distinct; no universal standalone-use or bystander claim.
Both retracted reports stay excluded, distinct from the three published correction notices.
Dated sponsor 13/31 and 2/5 denominators, completed escalation and recruiting registries are separated from peer-reviewed benefit or confirmation.
All default/dark diagrams viewed. Four have pale inline fills with weak dark-theme contrast; no asset imported. Guide rendering/theme change remains an owner/product follow-up.
The parent explains conditional supply, capture, uptake and release without a binary first-binding rule or a universal vessel-wall bottleneck.
The field distinguishes delivery-antigen negativity from T-cell-recognised antigen and treats cross-priming as a claim needing functional evidence.
The reader calls symbols schematic, not an atomic binding site or clinical threshold. The crowded leader remains a Guide artwork issue.
Reader text explains segment passage and enzyme-associated ends without using the ambiguous arrow as proof. Footer/arrow edits remain with the Guide.
All 14 theme files viewed whole. Reuse, omitted acrolein and the weekly/two-weekly fixed-window arithmetic are qualified in reader prose; no new dose-density or source-pixel claim.
Source hashes identify pinned figures; render hashes identify a particular rendering run. No cross-run pixel identity is inferred.
Existing quantity and fixed-window notes remain on dose-dense-chemotherapy. Regimen keeps clinical trial evidence and actual scheduling context.
Dated label cumulative-risk and AML/MDS figures retain their schedule and follow-up; deterministic lifetime cutoff removed.
Broad parent registered in draft 375; narrower companion remains in draft 371. Bidirectional related fields are held until the ids coexist.

Baker correction DOI resolved but publisher text blocked; Citron erratum remains unidentified at DOI/text level. The corresponding numerical teaching requirements remain partial despite exact abstract-scoped text.
Current canonical records were supplemented by AST record identity and exact field values; no divergent candidate diff or union of conflicting scalar objects was applied.
Personal-case pointers were excluded from signatures and public teaching artifacts. No private case prose or links are copied.

independentAcceptance: The prior independent objections were considered and re-checked. These dispositions are coordinator judgments, not a new independent, expert or learner acceptance.
